Frequently asked questions

Billing & Account Details

How does the Free Plan work?

The Free Plan includes 5 successful uploads per calendar month with full multi-channel scheduling to Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube. Quota resets on the 1st of every month automatically.

How do 100% free coupons like CODE work?

Applying a 100% free coupon gives you instant Creator Pro access for the duration mentioned in the offer without asking for a card or payment. After expiry, your account automatically returns to the Free plan.

What happens if I reach the 5-upload limit on Free?

New publishing is temporarily paused until the next month or until you upgrade to Pro. Your connected social accounts, scheduled posts, and dashboard remain 100% accessible and safe.
